title: The Legend of Zelda Is the Only Big Name Willing to Go Up Against GTA 6
description: According to Push Square, while major publishers avoid GTA 6, Nintendo is sending The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake for Switch 2 to launch on Nov 5.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## The Industry's Fear of Rockstar's Juggernaut

For the best part of 2026, the gaming community and industry analysts have been discussing a singular trend: no major publishers are willing to release their games anywhere near *GTA 6*. Rockstar Games' upcoming blockbuster commands such massive market dominance and attention that most companies have actively shifted their release schedules to avoid getting entirely overshadowed.

However, not every company operates under the same playbook. Nintendo, it turns out, is simply not cut from the same cloth.

## Zelda Steps Up to the Plate

According to a report by gaming media outlet Push Square, *The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time* remake for the Switch 2 now has a confirmed global launch date. The highly anticipated title is scheduled to arrive worldwide on November 5th.

This placement puts the game's release just two weeks before Rockstar's juggernaut lands. In a year where competing publishers are desperately running for cover, Nintendo's decision to drop a massive title right on the doorstep of *GTA 6*'s launch window stands out as one of the boldest moves of 2026.

## A Clash of Titans Awaits

As November approaches, the stage is set for a historic showdown between two of the industry's most influential franchises. Whether players will divide their time and budgets between the streets of Vice City and the lands of Hyrule remains to be seen, but the collision course is now locked in.

## Editor's Take

Dodging *GTA 6* has been the default survival strategy for publishers this year. Nintendo's willingness to launch *The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time* remake just two weeks prior shows immense confidence in the Switch 2 and the enduring power of the Zelda franchise. It's a thrilling clash that fans won't want to miss.
